findings.title: Light-theme color of embedded-post username changed from 30% to 70% lightness
findings.body: In `.embedded-posts .topic-meta-data h5 a`, the original rule was `color: scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%)`. The PR changed it to `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 30%))`. The intent of the PR is only to provide a `$secondary`-based value for dark themes, but the light-theme value was also changed (30% -> 70% lightness), so embedded-post usernames will render much lighter than before for all light color schemes. The light argument should have stayed `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%)`.

findings.title: Light-theme color of topic-map h3 changed from 20% to 50% lightness
findings.body: In mobile/topic-post.scss `.topic-map h3`, the original `color: scale-color($primary, $lightness: 20%)` was replaced with `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 50%))`. The light-theme value was unintentionally changed from 20% to 50% lightness instead of just adding a dark-theme alternative, so the topic map heading will be noticeably lighter (and inconsistent with the desktop equivalent, which kept 20%) on light themes.

findings.title: custom-message-length light-theme color changed to 30% and inverted vs desktop
findings.body: In mobile/modal.scss `.custom-message-length`, the original `color: scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%)` was replaced with `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 70%))`. The light-theme argument was changed from 70% to 30% lightness, and the desktop version of the same element (desktop/modal.scss) uses the opposite order: `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 30%))`. On light themes the mobile flag-modal character counter will be much darker than intended and inconsistent with desktop; the arguments appear to have been accidentally swapped.

findings.title: Light-theme color of group member name changed from 30% to 50% lightness
findings.body: In desktop/user.scss `.group-member-info .name`, the original `color: scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%)` was replaced with `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 50%))`. The light-theme value changed from 30% to 50% lightness even though the PR only intends to add a dark-theme fallback, so group member names on the user page will render lighter than before on light color schemes.
